Methods

Association results for 20,000 SNPs on 23 chromosomes were shown as a Manhattan plot of -log10 p at the cumulative genomic position, with the genome-wide significance line at p = 5e-8 and the suggestive line at p = 1e-5. 45 SNPs reached genome-wide significance and 75 passed the suggestive line (smallest p = 9.61e-22); the lead SNP of each chromosome with p < 5e-8 is labelled (4 shown). The QQ plot compares the observed -log10 p with the expected uniform quantiles, (i - 0.5) / n, with a 95% band from the Beta(i, n - i + 1) distribution of the order statistics. The genomic inflation factor was lambda_GC = 1.082, the median of the 1-df chi-square statistics over its expected value of 0.455. All 20,000 SNPs are drawn in the Manhattan panel. The QQ panel draws every SNP with p < 0.01 and, for the others, one point per 0.005 by 0.005 cell of -log10 p, because the sorted points lie on one curve. The association test itself was performed upstream; this figure summarises its output. Drawn in Python 3.10.12 with matplotlib 3.10.9, scipy 1.15.3 and adjustText 1.4.0.
